dave: Heads-up: we're opening A10G reserved pools in eu-west-3 (Paris) and ap-northeast-3 (Osaka) next week. These are dedicated, non-preemptible reservations for customers needing predictable throughput.

lara: Nice. Any regional quota limits and how do customers request extra capacity?

dave: Initial quotas: eu-west-3 = 64 GPUs reserved; ap-northeast-3 = 48 GPUs reserved. Customers can request quota increases via the Console request form; priority given to committed customers. We'll publish per-account soft limits and expected provisioning lead times.

marta: Billing and SKU mapping? Will these map to existing A10G pricing or be separate?

dave: Billing: same A10G reserved rate as other regions. We'll add a region tag `region=eu-west-3`/`ap-northeast-3` on usage exports. No change to committed contract math; migration wizard will include any prorated adjustments.

sre-bot: [capacity-snapshot] eu-west-3: reserved cap=64 A10G GPUs; available today=60. ap-northeast-3: reserved cap=48; available=48.

lara: API/CLI change for customers who want to pin to these regions?

dave: Add `--region eu-west-3|ap-northeast-3` to redwoodctl reservations and support `region` in the Reservations API. Example: `redwoodctl reservations create --model a10g --region eu-west-3 --count 8 --type reserved`. Console will show region selector on the reserve flow.

marta: SLA / fallback rules if we run out of reserved capacity?

dave: Reserved pools maintain existing SLA. Fallback policy: if reserved unavailable and customer has multi-region failover enabled, requests will route to the customer's next preferred region (subject to compatibility). We will not automatically move traffic to other customer's dedicated pools.

billing-bot: [note] Usage exports will include `pool_type` and `pool_region` columns for reconciliation.

lara: Ops/runbook owner? Need incident playbook for capacity pressure in a new region.

dave: SRE owns the initial runbook. I'll post the draft to #eng-sre and tag SRE leads; support will own customer comms.

dave: Rollout timeline:
- 2026-05-20: internal docs + quota config live
- 2026-05-27: invite-only preview (partner customers)
- 2026-06-03: GA open for reserved in both regions

dave: If you need inclusion in the preview list, DM me with account id and desired region. We'll share AE-ready positioning slides after GA.
